summary: This week brought the eighth batch of UAP files from government archives, featuring radar analysis of an object moving at approximately Mach 2.5 near U.S. airspace, alongside claims about unexplained implants allegedly removed from witnesses and ongoing mysteries surrounding Skinwalker Ranch. Journalist Ross Coulthart continued examining specific cases, including an unusual "jellyfish"-shaped sighting over Alaska and alleged UAP-summoning experiments in the Australian desert, while physicist Avi Loeb criticized the quality of recent disclosures and outlined plans for a dedicated UFO-spotting telescope. The timing intersects with broader questions about what incoming administration officials like Stephen Miller might mean for UAP transparency, though the White House's current position on disclosure remains unclear despite reports of ongoing briefings and investigations. No new official government documents were added to the public record this week, leaving the pace of formal institutional disclosure relatively flat even as independent researchers and media outlets continue pressing the subject.
